messages:
Ana (Support): FYI — BrightCo reported a spike of autopay failures this morning. ~120 invoices attempted, ~18% failing with card declines and a cluster of 3DS/auth issues. Sample tx id: tx_8a4f2b7e. Customer is seeing 'Payment failed: issuer_decline' in their UI.
Maria (CS): Can you paste a couple of raw failure rows (merchant_id, tx_id, acquirer_code, error text)? I need to reply to BrightCo with specifics.
Ana (Support): Pasting two anonymized rows from PG logs:
```
merchant_id: brightco-prod
tx_id: tx_8a4f2b7e
amount: 12500
acquirer_code: 05
acquirer_text: insufficient_funds
3ds_result: none
fingerprint: fp_user_87
```
```
merchant_id: brightco-prod
tx_id: tx_b1c3d9aa
amount: 3000
acquirer_code: 410
acquirer_text: auth_rejected_by_acs
3ds_result: acs_timeout
fingerprint: fp_user_92
```
Lee (Payments): I see two patterns: a) classic issuer '05' insufficient_funds b) flows where the ACS session timed out or returned abort (we get acs_timeout / challenge_not_completed). The acquirer logs for the second group show 'device_fingerprint_mismatch' flagged by the fraud vendor before 3DS kick-off.
Jared (Eng): Can you share the Redwood API payload for the failing autoresolve attempt? curious about 3ds options and any gateway flags.
Ana (Support): Here's the POST we sent to /v1/payments/attempt (redacted):
```
POST /v1/payments/attempt
{
  "merchant_id": "brightco-prod",
  "invoice_id": "inv_2024_0422_99",
  "source": {"type": "card", "token": "tok_****", "fingerprint": "fp_user_87"},
  "amount": 12500,
  "options": {"attempt_3ds": true, "3ds_max_retries": 1, "autopay": true}
}
```
Lee (Payments): The request looks fine. Fraud score pipeline is triggering a device_fingerprint_mismatch for a segment of their user base (likely cookie/device changes due to Chrome privacy updates + iframe auth). When that happens we mark as high risk and the acquirer often forces a challenge; if the ACS doesn't respond fast (or the browser blocks the iframe) we get acs_timeout.
Maria (CS): BrightCo mentioned many of these are autopay / saved cards — they don't have a UX for customers to re-auth. They ask if we can silently retry or fall back to manual.
Jared (Eng): Two engineering notes: 1) our 3ds iframe TTL currently is 15s for redirect challenge flows — if the merchant embeds in a headless webview that can be longer. Consider increasing to 30s for autopay mode where user is not present? 2) We should log device_fingerprint hash + fraud vendor id in the transaction metadata for faster correlation. I'll open an infra PR.
Gina (Oncall): Opening incident for this merchant so we can track mitigation steps. INC-2024-0456 created.
reconcile-bot: Reconcile check: 120 attempted, 22 failed. Fail reasons breakdown: ["insufficient_funds": 9, "acs_timeout": 8, "fraud_reject": 5].
Lee (Payments): Immediate remediation suggestions: - Pause autopay for brightco-prod (merchant toggle) - Mark affected txs for manual retry only after card update - Add temporary rule to bypass device_fingerprint strictness for merchant_id=brightco-prod while we investigate (low-risk option flag).
Ana (Support): BrightCo asked if this could be related to recent library upgrade on their checkout iframe. They rolled a small change on 2024-04-22 at 08:12 UTC. Could explain more iframe timeouts.
Jared (Eng): If their iframe change disabled third-party cookies or changed postMessage behavior, ACS iframes may fail silently. We should capture the ACS iframe origin and error events in our logs for the next 24h. I'll push a small debug flag to increase 3ds logging for that merchant.
Maria (CS): Brighton (contact) asked about refunds/errors for the failed invoices. They want a clear customer message: "Payment failed due to authentication or issuer rejection — please update card or contact your bank." I'll send that once we confirm.
Lee (Payments): For the 'insufficient_funds' group: recommend retry with backoff (standard 3 attempts spaced 1hr/6hr/24hr) and surface clear messaging. For 'acs_timeout' group: don't auto-retry; surface challenge_required to the customer and prompt manual payment.
Gina (Oncall): Confirmed change actions: 1) Pause autopay for brightco-prod (done) 2) Increase 3DS debug logging for merchant (in progress) 3) Add temporary fraud vendor exception (pending approvals) 4) CS message draft for BrightCo (Maria)
Ana (Support): Thanks. I'll reply to BrightCo: pause autopay temporarily, prompt customers to re-auth their saved card from account page, and we'll follow up in 24h with logs.
Maria (CS): Draft message ready, sending after Jared confirms debug logs enabled.
Jared (Eng): Debug logs enabled for merchant brightco-prod — will collect next 24h and share a dump (redacted PI). Expect more detail on device_fingerprint mismatches and ACS response times.
Ana (Support): Closing loop here once Maria confirms customer notification sent. Tagging @Lee and @Gina for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
